component.name: Dragonwilds Sync
component.summary: Dragonwilds World discovery, synchronization, characters, and profiles

description.p: Dragonwilds Sync augments RuneScape: Dragonwilds World discovery with independently verified synchronization fingerprints, profile-aware file synchronization, character tools, Private Worlds, and map data.

The Linux package is a Proton-aware client launcher and native Linux dedicated-server manager. It can install through SteamCMD or link the documented rs_server layout; Linux firewall policy remains under the host administrator's control.
